label: Blind sample 023: Hansen forest loss 2021, tile 00N_060W

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.05 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2021 (90% interval −0.08 to +0.01). Of 60 untouched cells given the same test, 22 showed a divergence this large (placebo p = 0.38). But: the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.04 vs typical 0.03).
reasons: the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.04 vs typical 0.03)

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
